subject: spt-dy
title: SPT.DY.------AF.POST.
description: First of two diagrams in TRF(II)-36. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'The spiritual alignment of a given culture is directly related to the vibrational and dynamic factors which outline how a given time zone is understood. Thus, if the concept of transformation has anything to do with "actualness" of change, then this concept must also imply that the composite results of that change be addressed with regards for what they mean on a dynamic (i.e., cosmic-spiritual-practical) level. The solidification of an alternative spiritual affinity alignment is directly related to the concept of transformation.' The crossing diagrams how spiritual-dynamics structurally meets affinity-postulation at the alternative-spiritual-affinity-alignment scale: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) crossed with AF-POST (affinity postulation — the form's actual postulating-from-affinity). SPT-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; AF-POST sits at center-right as partner-axis. POL-P (political policies) rises from the main line at upper-center and carries CN-INFO (controlled information). A second line rises from the main line through MT-INTR (multiple interpretation), which sits at its junction, to INFO-FM (information forum); from MT-INTR runs INFO-CON (information convergence), which carries (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation). T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) hangs at lower-left and RT-DY (reality dynamics) and DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture's center) at center-bottom as the subject-side downward chain.
